model.earthFixedTransform: TEME to ECF via GMST; world = (x, z, -y) / 6378.137
model.sampleMode: Direct SGP4 from fresh baseline copies in a dedicated worker; one complete position/normal packet at one UTC. Float64 transport, Float32 GPU attributes. No interpolation or synthetic population filling.

rights.attribution: CelesTrak standard GP; USSPACECOM / 18th Space Defense Squadron via Space-Track.org.
rights.fields: Basic GP/OMM fields only. Kuiper group membership and names are provider-supplied. No optional status, availability or service metadata.
rights.changes: NORAD identities normalized to decimal strings; UTC suffix and documented Earth/TEME/UTC/SGP4 defaults explicit; per-object age bounds added.

featured.selection: Densest 1-degree opening-time angular-momentum-normal neighbourhood among eligible, near-circular (eccentricity <0.003), 85–130 minute records; lowest numeric NORAD ID breaks ties.
